plugin.name: Coolify for Termix
plugin.description: Coolify inside Termix: servers become hosts (tunnels included), one-click container shells, deploys, logs, variables, backups and alerts, and the full Coolify API.

empty.title: No Coolify connections yet
empty.hint: Coolify connections and their servers and resources will show here.

noConnection.title: No Coolify connection
noConnection.hint: Add a connection under Connections to see its resources.

shellTab.title: Coolify shell
shellTab.empty: This tab has no container to open. Open a shell from a resource in the Coolify tab.
shellTab.fingerprints: Coolify's fingerprint for this host's key:
shellTab.noConsole: There is no database console for this engine, so this is a shell in the container.

noTerminal.title: SSH Terminal isn't running
noTerminal.hint: Turn on the SSH Terminal plugin to open the shell here, or run this command in a terminal on the server.

pick.title: Pick a container
pick.hint: Several containers belong to this resource.

errors.not-linked: Link this server first: sync it from Coolify to make it a Linked host.
errors.not-running: The container isn't running. Start the resource, then try again.
errors.container-not-found: No container of this resource was found on its server.
errors.host-key: Open a server terminal once to trust this host's key.
errors.no-host-access: You can't open this server's Linked host. Ask its owner for server access.
errors.failed: The shell could not be opened.

hostSection.title: Coolify
hostSection.locked: Termix keeps this host read only while Coolify manages it. Sync it to pick up changes, or unlink it to edit it here.
hostSection.unlinked: Unlinked. This is now an ordinary host.
hostSection.unlinkFailed: The host could not be unlinked.
hostSection.notLinked: This host is not linked to Coolify.
hostSection.tunnelReadOnly: SSH Terminal's tunnel settings stay read only while the host is linked.

view.title: View Coolify
view.description: Open the plugin and read the Coolify connections you own or were granted.

operate.title: Operate Coolify resources
operate.description: Start, stop, restart and deploy, run tasks and backups, read logs, and open container shells and consoles.

configure.title: Configure Coolify
configure.description: Edit resources, variables, storage, keys, sources, DNS and notifications, and create or import resources.

administer.title: Administer Coolify
administer.description: Delete resources, create, delete and transfer servers, provision cloud servers, change instance settings and share connections.

mcp.title: Use the Coolify MCP endpoint
mcp.description: Call the plugin's MCP endpoint. Each call still needs the permission of the action it runs.

allowPolling.label: Allow polling
allowPolling.description: Let connections poll Coolify for changes.

minPollSeconds.label: Minimum poll interval
minPollSeconds.description: The shortest time, in seconds, a connection may wait between polls.

allowKeyCopy.label: Allow copying Coolify SSH keys
allowKeyCopy.description: Copy a server's SSH key from Coolify into a Termix credential. When off, people pick an existing Termix credential instead.

allowSharing.label: Allow sharing connections
allowSharing.description: Let connection owners share a connection with other Termix users.

allowProvisioning.label: Allow cloud provisioning
allowProvisioning.description: Let people create servers at cloud providers through Coolify.

allowStatusPages.label: Allow public status pages
allowStatusPages.description: Let connection owners publish read-only status pages that anyone with the link can open.

allowMcpChanges.label: Allow changes over MCP
allowMcpChanges.description: Let MCP clients run actions that change things. Deploy and restart are allowed either way.

allowExec.label: Allow running commands in containers through the API and MCP
allowExec.description: Each connection also needs its owner to turn this on.

coolifyLinked.label: Linked to Coolify
coolifyLinked.description: This host is managed by a Coolify connection.

connectionId.label: Coolify connection
connectionId.listDescription: One of your Coolify connections. Leave empty to list what you can call on any of them.

baseUrl.label: Coolify URL
baseUrl.description: The address you open Coolify at, like https://coolify.example.com.

token.label: API token
token.description: A Coolify API token. Recommended abilities: read, read:sensitive, write and deploy.
token.keepDescription: Leave empty to keep the stored token.

allowPrivate.label: On my local network
allowPrivate.description: Allow a private or local address for this Coolify.

caCert.label: CA certificate
caCert.description: A PEM certificate to trust when Coolify uses a private CA.

removeHosts.label: Also delete the Linked hosts
removeHosts.description: Off: the hosts made for this connection's servers stay as ordinary, editable hosts.

serverUuid.label: Coolify server
serverUuid.description: Only resources on this Coolify server (its uuid). Leave empty for all.

linkedServerUuid.label: Coolify server
linkedServerUuid.description: The uuid of a Coolify server that has a Linked host.

uuid.label: Resource
uuid.description: The uuid of an application, service, database or service part.

choices.label: Servers
choices.description: Optional. A JSON list of { uuid, include, addressOverride, credentialId }. Leave empty to sync every server with its saved address and credential.

wait.label: Wait for the deployment
wait.description: Follow the deployment until it finishes or fails, and report which.

part.label: Part
part.description: Optional. A Part of the service, by uuid, to open instead of the service's containers.

container.label: Container
container.description: Optional. A container name from an earlier list of choices.

console.label: Open
console.description: A shell in the container, or the database's own console.

confirmInstall.label: Install every pending update
confirmInstall.description: Must be on. Updates to Docker packages restart every container on the server.

confirmName.label: Server name
confirmName.description: Type the Coolify server's exact name to reboot it.

kind.label: What to do
kind.description: The companion feature to use. Each one needs its plugin installed.

params.label: Details
params.readDescription: A JSON object: uuid for a resource (uptime, log-search, db-login, dns-list) or serverUuid for a server (security, backups-failed, host-metrics, db-logins).
params.changeDescription: A JSON object with uuid, the resource. For dns also fqdn and optional type (A, AAAA or CNAME) and content.

apiParams.label: Parameters (JSON)
apiParams.description: Path and query parameters as a JSON object, like {"uuid": "..."}. Never stored in run history.

resourceUuid.label: Coolify resource
resourceUuid.description: The uuid of the Coolify application, service or database.

recordId.label: DNS record
recordId.description: The id of a DNS record made here for that resource, from the dns-list read.

title.label: Title
title.description: Shown at the top of the public page.

resources.label: Resources
resources.description: The applications, services or databases the page shows, by uuid.

statusPageConnection.label: Connection
statusPageConnection.description: Only this connection's pages. Leave empty for all of yours.

statusPageUrl.label: Page URL
statusPageUrl.description: The public link. Shown once and never stored.

handoffId.label: Handoff id
handoffId.description: Takes the URL once, with the status page handoff route or the MCP tool take_status_page_url.

operationId.label: Coolify operation
operationId.description: The Coolify API operation, by its operation id, like list-applications.

body.label: Body (JSON)
body.description: The request body as JSON. Never stored in run history.

lines.label: Lines
lines.description: How many lines from the end, up to 10,000.

confirmLogs.label: Read the logs
confirmLogs.description: Logs can hold secrets. Set to true to read them.

listConnections.title: List Coolify connections
listConnections.description: The Coolify connections you own or were granted.

connectionProbe.title: Check a Coolify connection
connectionProbe.description: Checks the Coolify version, the team and what the token may do, without changing anything.

connectionCreate.title: Connect a Coolify instance
connectionCreate.description: Checks the instance and token, then saves the connection with the token encrypted.

connectionUpdate.title: Change a Coolify connection
connectionUpdate.description: Changes a connection you own. An empty token or Cloudflare Access value keeps the stored one.

connectionDelete.title: Remove a Coolify connection
connectionDelete.description: Removes the connection from Termix. Nothing changes in Coolify, and Linked hosts become ordinary hosts.

listResourcesAll.title: List Coolify resources
listResourcesAll.description: A connection's applications, services with their parts, and databases, with status, server, project, environment and domains. No secrets.

resourceGet.title: Read a Coolify resource
resourceGet.description: One application, service, database or service part, without secrets.

syncPreview.title: Preview Coolify host sync
syncPreview.description: Lists each Coolify server and the Termix host it is or would become, without changing anything.

syncApply.title: Sync Coolify servers into hosts
syncApply.description: Creates or updates a locked Linked host for each server. Servers that need an address or a credential are reported and skipped, and servers gone from Coolify are never deleted.

unlink.title: Unlink a Coolify host
unlink.description: Releases the lock on a Linked host and makes it an ordinary host. The host is kept.

listResources.title: List a host's Coolify resources
listResources.description: The applications, services, Parts and databases on this Linked host's Coolify server. Empty for a host that isn't linked.

deploy.title: Deploy a Coolify resource
deploy.description: Deploys the resource through Coolify, optionally with a force rebuild. A Part deploys its service.

start.title: Start a Coolify resource
start.description: Starts the resource or Part through Coolify.

restart.title: Restart a Coolify resource
restart.description: Restarts the resource through Coolify. A Part restarts on its own.

stop.title: Stop a Coolify resource
stop.description: Stops the resource or Part through Coolify. It stays stopped until started again.

syncHost.title: Sync this host from Coolify
syncHost.description: Updates this Linked host from its Coolify server. Other servers are left as they are.

resourceDeploy.title: Deploy a Coolify resource (no host)
resourceDeploy.description: Deploys a resource of a connection by its uuid, for resources whose server has no Linked host.

resourceRestart.title: Restart a Coolify resource (no host)
resourceRestart.description: Restarts a resource or Part of a connection by its uuid, for resources whose server has no Linked host.

resourceAction.title: Start or stop a Coolify resource (no host)
resourceAction.description: Starts or stops a resource or Part of a connection by its uuid, for resources whose server has no Linked host.

signalDegraded.title: Degraded Coolify resources
signalDegraded.description: How many resources on this Linked host's Coolify server are restarting, dead or unhealthy.

signalServer.title: Coolify server status
signalServer.description: Whether Coolify can reach this Linked host's server.

signalUpdates.title: Coolify security updates
signalUpdates.description: Security updates Coolify's last update check found on this Linked host's server.

signalDeploying.title: Coolify deployments running
signalDeploying.description: How many resources are deploying now, across your Coolify connections.

deploymentFailed.title: Coolify deployment failed
deploymentFailed.description: A deployment failed or was cancelled in Coolify.

containerRestarted.title: Coolify container restarted
containerRestarted.description: A resource's container restarted on its own.

serverUnreachable.title: Coolify server unreachable
serverUnreachable.description: Coolify can no longer reach a server.

shellCommand.title: Coolify container shell command
shellCommand.description: The docker exec command that opens a shell or database console in a resource's container, run on its Linked host. It holds no password: a console reads its credentials inside the container. Needs connect access to the Linked host.

serverUpdates.title: Coolify server updates
serverUpdates.description: Pending package updates on a Coolify server: Coolify's last check and the plugin's own, with security updates, Docker risk and whether a reboot is needed.

serverUpdatesCheck.title: Check a Coolify server for updates
serverUpdatesCheck.description: Re-reads pending updates on the server's Linked host, through the Package Manager plugin when it runs, otherwise over SSH.

serverUpdatesInstall.title: Install updates on a Coolify server
serverUpdatesInstall.description: Upgrades every package on the server's Linked host, through the Package Manager plugin when it runs, otherwise over SSH. Docker updates restart every container on it.

serverReboot.title: Reboot a Coolify server
serverReboot.description: Reboots the server over SSH on its Linked host. Every Coolify application, service and database on it goes down until it is back.

companionRead.title: Read from a companion plugin
companionRead.description: Reads what a companion plugin knows about a Coolify resource or server: Uptime monitors, Log Search results, Security Center score, failed backups, saved database logins, and DNS records made here.

companion.title: Use a companion plugin
companion.description: Creates a DNS record for a resource's domain, or pauses and resumes its Uptime monitors.

kinds.logSearch: Search a resource's logs across servers
kinds.security: Security Center score of a server
kinds.dbLogins: Saved logins for a server's databases
kinds.dnsList: DNS records made for a resource

companionDnsRemove.title: Remove a DNS record made here
companionDnsRemove.description: Deletes a DNS record this connection created for the resource, through the DNS plugin. Only records made here can be removed.

statusPageList.title: List status pages
statusPageList.description: Your public status pages: title, connection and the resources each shows. Never their links.

statusPageCreate.title: Publish a status page
statusPageCreate.description: A public, read-only page with the chosen resources' status. The link is handed over once and never stored.

statusPageRotate.title: Give a status page a new link
statusPageRotate.description: The old link stops working at once. The new one is handed over once.

statusPageRevoke.title: Revoke a status page
statusPageRevoke.description: The link stops working and the page is removed.

listApiReads.title: List Coolify API reads
listApiReads.description: The Coolify API read operations you may run, for coolify.api-read.

listApiOperations.title: List Coolify API operations
listApiOperations.description: Every Coolify API operation you may call, for coolify.api-call.

apiRead.title: Read from the Coolify API
apiRead.description: Runs one Coolify API read (GET). It needs the permission and access that read needs; secrets in the answer are masked.

apiCall.title: Call the Coolify API
apiCall.description: Runs any Coolify API operation. It needs the permission and access that operation needs, and a confirm. Secrets in the request and answer are masked in history.

logsTail.title: Coolify container logs
logsTail.description: Recent logs of a resource's container. They come from Coolify when your access and the token allow it (read:sensitive), else from docker logs over SSH on its Linked host, which needs connect access to that host. source says which. Needs confirm: true.

connections.title: Connections
connections.loadFailed: The connections could not be loaded.

empty.title: No Coolify connections yet
empty.hint: Add a connection with your Coolify URL and an API token.

form.name: Name
form.tokenKeep: Leave empty to keep the stored token
form.abilitiesHint: Create the token in Coolify under Keys & Tokens, API tokens, with the abilities read, read:sensitive, write and deploy. Everything works except deletes and instance settings, and a leaked token can't wipe your resources. Add delete, or use root, only if you want those from Termix.
form.cfAccessHint: Only when your Coolify dashboard sits behind Cloudflare Access: a service token's ID and secret. Host sync also gives it to SSH Terminal on hosts behind Cloudflare tunnels.
form.cfAccessKeep: Leave empty to keep the stored value
form.allowPrivateHint: Allow a private or local address, like 192.168.1.10.
form.caCertHint: Paste a PEM certificate when Coolify uses a private CA.
form.required: Name, URL and token are required.

probe.title: What the token can do

steps.sshTerminal: SSH Terminal carries the Cloudflare tunnels

skipped.nothing-to-probe: Not checked: this token sees nothing to try it on yet, so it may still have this ability. Check again after adding one.

probe.scoped: This token is scoped to some projects or resources. It can't see servers, so there is no host sync, no shells and no keys, and it can't set up notifications. Applications, services, databases, deploys and logs still work.

delete.title: Remove {{name}}?
delete.description: Termix forgets this connection and its token. Nothing changes in Coolify. Hosts made for its servers become ordinary hosts.

errors.forbidden: Only the connection's owner can change it.

mcp.title: Use with an MCP client
mcp.description: Point an MCP client at this address to use the Coolify actions as tools. Each call runs as the key's user, with that user's permissions, approvals and history.
mcp.loadFailed: The MCP endpoint could not be loaded.

steps.title: Set it up
steps.key: In Termix, create an API key with the scope operations:read (read tools only) or operations:run.
steps.paste: Paste the client config into your MCP client and put the key in place of the placeholder.
steps.changes: Changes over MCP stay off until an admin turns on "Allow changes over MCP" in the plugin's settings. Read tools work either way.

causes.target-changed: The connection's address, token or Cloudflare Access settings changed during the sync, so nothing more was written. Sync again.
causes.api-disabled: API access is turned off in Coolify.
causes.not-coolify: The address answered, but not as a Coolify API.
causes.unsupported-by-instance: This Coolify doesn't have this feature.
causes.unsupported-version: This plugin needs Coolify 4.4 or newer.
causes.excluded: The plugin never runs this operation.
causes.upload-unsupported: File uploads can't go through the plugin; import from a server path or S3.
causes.unknown-operation: The plugin doesn't know this operation.
causes.not-a-read: This operation is not a read.
causes.forbidden: You don't have the permission or access this needs.
causes.invalid-input: Some values are missing or not valid.
causes.not-masked: That value is not a masked one.
causes.token-ability: This connection's token can't run this operation.

fixes.unreachable: Check the URL. If Coolify is on your local network, turn on "On my local network" under Advanced.
fixes.unauthorized: Create a new API token in Coolify and paste it here.
fixes.api-disabled: Turn on API access in Coolify, Settings, Advanced.
fixes.forbidden-ability: Give the token the read:sensitive ability in Coolify if you want this.
fixes.access-redirect: Add a Cloudflare Access service token under Advanced.
fixes.not-coolify: Use the address you open Coolify at, without /api at the end.

connect.title: Connect Coolify
connect.description: Bring your Coolify servers, applications, services and databases into Termix.
connect.intro: Add your Coolify URL and an API token. You can skip this and add connections later from the Coolify tab.

resources.title: Resources
resources.loadFailed: The resources could not be loaded.
resources.search: Search names, domains, projects and servers

empty.title: No resources
empty.hint: This connection has no applications, services or databases yet.

noMatch.title: Nothing matches
noMatch.hint: Change the search or the filters.

detail.missing: This resource is no longer in Coolify.

shell.hint: Opens a terminal in this resource's container on its Linked host. A database console signs in with the credentials the container already holds.
shell.noAccess: Opening a shell needs the Operate Coolify permission and operate access to this connection.

sync.title: Sync servers from {{name}}
sync.intro: Each Coolify server becomes a Linked host in the Coolify folder. Linked hosts stay read only while Coolify manages them; unlink one to edit it.
sync.loadFailed: The servers could not be read from Coolify.
sync.empty: This Coolify connection has no servers the token can see.
sync.pickConnection: Pick the connection to sync servers from.
sync.noConnections: Add a Coolify connection first, then sync its servers.
sync.needsConfigure: Syncing servers into hosts needs the Coolify configure permission.
sync.notOwner: Only the owner of this connection can sync its servers into hosts.
sync.scopedToken: This connection uses a scoped token, which can't see servers, so there is no host sync. Use a token that isn't scoped to sync servers.
sync.addressHint: Coolify reaches this server as {{ip}}, which Termix can't use. Enter the address Termix should connect to.
sync.addressOptionalHint: Optional. Leave empty to connect to {{ip}}, the address Coolify uses.
sync.credentialHint: Coolify's key for this server can't be copied, so pick one of your Termix credentials.
sync.unlinkFailed: The host could not be changed.

removeConfirm.title: Remove the host for {{name}}?
removeConfirm.description: The Termix host is deleted. Nothing changes in Coolify.

causes.needs-address: This is the server Coolify runs on. Enter the address Termix should use for it.
causes.needs-credential: The token can't read this server's key, or copying keys is turned off. Pick a Termix credential.
causes.needs-ssh-terminal: Turn on the SSH Terminal plugin to reach servers behind Cloudflare tunnels.
causes.ssh-terminal-too-old: Update SSH Terminal to 1.2.0 or newer; older versions tunnel only the terminal.
causes.needs-ssh-terminal-to-clear-tunnel: This server is no longer behind a Cloudflare tunnel, but its host still has SSH Terminal's tunnel settings. Turn on SSH Terminal so the next sync can clear them; until then the host is left as it is.
causes.host-write-failed: Termix refused the host. Check your permissions to create and edit hosts.
causes.credential-not-found: The picked credential isn't one of your Termix credentials any more. Pick another one.
causes.credential-check-failed: Your Termix credentials could not be read, so the picked credential can't be checked. Try again, or ask an admin for the permission to view credentials.

hostDot.degraded: Coolify reports this server as not usable
hostDot.gone: This server is gone from Coolify

unlinkConfirm.title: Unlink {{name}} from Coolify?
unlinkConfirm.description: The host stays as an ordinary, editable host. Coolify is not changed.

stopConfirm.title: Stop {{name}}?
stopConfirm.description: Coolify stops it, and it stays stopped until you start it again.

forceConfirm.title: Force rebuild {{name}}?
forceConfirm.description: Coolify rebuilds it without the build cache, which takes longer than a deploy.

updates.title: Package updates
updates.loadFailed: The updates could not be read.
updates.checkFailed: The last check failed, so the updates are unknown
updates.coolifyRecord: Coolify's own record ({{when}}): {{summary}}. It catches up at Coolify's next scheduled check.
updates.pending: Package Manager is waiting for an approval before it installs.
updates.rebootStarted: {{server}} is rebooting. Its Coolify apps come back once it is up.

installConfirm.title: Install {{count}} updates on {{server}}?
installConfirm.dockerWarning: Updates marked Restarts Docker restart the Docker daemon: every Coolify app on this server stops and starts again while they install.

rebootConfirm.title: Reboot {{server}}?
rebootConfirm.warning: Every Coolify application, service and database on {{server}} goes down until the server is back.

errors.not-linked: This Coolify server has no Linked host. Sync it first.
errors.host-forbidden: You don't have enough access to this host.
errors.name-mismatch: The name doesn't match the server's name.
errors.needs-sudo: The SSH login is not root and sudo asks for a password. Use root or passwordless sudo, as Coolify does.
errors.unsupported-os: This server has no apt, dnf, yum or pacman.
errors.companion-failed: The Package Manager plugin could not do this.
errors.host-key: Open a server terminal once to trust this host's key.
errors.target-changed: The connection's address, token or Cloudflare Access settings changed, so nothing ran. Try again.
errors.check-failed: The server's package lists could not be read, so the updates are unknown. Try again.
errors.companions-unknown: Termix's plugin list could not be read, so nothing ran. Try again.
errors.forbidden: You don't have permission to do this.

dns.contentHint: An IP address or host name. Leave empty to use the server's address.
dns.failed: The DNS record could not be created.
dns.removeFailed: The DNS record could not be removed.

removeConfirm.title: Remove the DNS record for {{fqdn}}?
removeConfirm.description: The DNS plugin deletes the record from your DNS provider.

uptime.title: Uptime
uptime.none: No Uptime monitor checks this resource's domains.
uptime.why: Uptime can't create HTTP monitors for other plugins, so add the monitor in the Uptime tab.
uptime.failed: Uptime could not be read, so it's not known which monitors check this resource.

logs.source: Docker logs, from Log Search. It can't filter by host.
logs.failed: Log Search could not search the logs.

databases.saved: A login for this database is saved in Databases.
databases.notSaved: Databases has no saved login for this database yet.
databases.summary: {{saved}} of {{total}} Coolify databases on this server have a saved login in Databases.

statusPages.title: Status pages for {{name}}
statusPages.description: A public, read-only page that shows the status of the resources you pick: their names, status and last deploy. No addresses, servers, logs or secrets. Anyone with the link can open it.
statusPages.loadFailed: The status pages could not be loaded.
statusPages.off: An admin has turned off public status pages. Existing pages answer "not found" until they are turned on again.

form.heading: New status page
form.title: Title
form.noResources: This connection has no resources to show.

created.title: Copy the link now
created.description: This link is shown once and is not stored anywhere. To get a link again, give the page a new link.

rotate.title: Give {{name}} a new link?
rotate.description: The current link stops working at once.

revoke.title: Revoke {{name}}?
revoke.description: The link stops working and the page is removed.

public.stale: Status may be out of date

apiConsole.title: API console
apiConsole.description: Every Coolify API operation as a form. Plain reads run at once; reads of secrets or logs and anything else ask first. Secrets in answers are masked.
apiConsole.loadFailed: The operations could not be loaded.
apiConsole.maskedHint: Secrets are masked. Reveal shows one value at a time; each reveal is recorded in the audit log and nothing is kept.
apiConsole.revealNeedsSensitive: This connection's token can't read secrets (read:sensitive), so values can't be revealed.
apiConsole.revealNeedsConfigure: Revealing a value needs permission to configure Coolify and configure access to this connection.
apiConsole.revealFailed: The value could not be revealed.
apiConsole.needsPermission: You don't have the permission this operation needs.

pick.title: Pick a container
pick.hint: This resource runs more than one container.

errors.not-linked: Link this server first: sync it from Coolify to read its logs over SSH.
errors.no-host-access: You can't open this server's Linked host, so its logs can't be read over SSH.
errors.host-key: Open a server terminal once to trust this host's key.
errors.container-not-found: No container of this resource was found on its server.
errors.locked: Your session is locked. Sign in again to follow logs.
errors.failed: The logs could not be read.
